name: thesis-mcwm-action-matrix-v18
interpretation: Matched action-authority restriction: use each reward's existing dual-control dataset and 50000-update initializer. Offline actions retain the actual recorded holding and speed; they are never relabelled. Source online policies, model-generated actions and deployed policies can choose only holding; the speed factor is exactly one. The critic keeps the two-coordinate representation to learn from the common offline data, but speed is not a policy degree of freedom and contributes no entropy or likelihood. Compare with the resident v16 headway and v4 passenger dual endpoints, with identical training budgets and evaluators. Headway uses same-vehicle feedback; passenger retains chronological global cost increments. Existing native one-action campaigns remain separate.
